caption_options.caption: Gottman calls them bids for connection. In real life, they sound like "dekh na," "suno," "taste this." Miss enough and the room changes. Love is noticing the quiet and turning back.
It was never about the tiny thing. It was about whether the other person would enter the moment. And sometimes love is just: "show me again?"
Inspired by Gottman's research on bids for connection. The small asks matter because they are rarely only about the thing. They are little doorways back to each other.
